Setting up Coop

✓ Coop project created
  Instructions, skills, and one task queue are ready for any agent.

Network access is filtered.
Other network traffic is blocked until you approve rules allowing it.

Finish setup — Coop needs a Git repository
  → git init
  → coop init

Sign in to an agent
  → coop login claude

Verify the sandbox
  → coop doctor

Start working
  → coop tasks add "Describe your first task"
  → coop loop claude
